_doc.what: One file per QA team. Copy this file to teams/<your-team-id>.json, replace every TODO, and commit it so your teammates get the same values. No secrets belong here; credentials stay in automation/config/credentials.local.js.
_doc.choose: Each person picks their team once: `team: '<your-team-id>'` in automation/config/credentials.local.js, or the env var QA_TEAM=<your-team-id>.
_doc.TODO: Any value still reading TODO stops the scripts that need it, with a message naming the field. Nothing falls back to another team's values.
_doc.jira.projectKey: Org-wide: every squad files stories and bugs in B10 (operator decision D-15). Change it only if your stories live elsewhere.
_doc.jira.bugIssueTypeId: Org-wide B10 bug schema: 10084. (Verify with GET /rest/api/2/issue/createmeta/B10/issuetypes.)
_doc.jira.bug.web / jira.bug.mobile: Squad (customfield_10183) and component values for web and mobile bugs. Delete mobile if your team does not test it; KEEP web even for a backend-only team (backend bugs use it). Values must match the Jira option text exactly.
_doc.browserstack.project: The Test Management project identifier (PR-<n>), as shown in the API, not the numeric id from the URL.
_doc.browserstack.numericProject: The numeric project id from a folder link: test-management.browserstack.com/projects/<numericProject>/folder/<id>.
_doc.browserstack.suiteFolder: Your team's root folder of approved test cases (numeric id). Story folders are created inside it.
_doc.surfaces: What your team tests: any of web, mobile, backend. Decides which platform knowledge loads and which scope questions Phase 0 asks.
_doc.domains: The product knowledge your stories may load: ids from qa-workflow/registry/knowledge.json (`domains`). Use [] if your product has none there yet; team onboarding creates one. Another team's domain loads only for a story where an operator approves it (qa-cli.js cross-domain).
